roe_pct.metric_note: Profit after tax (BDT -3,993.40mn) / period-end total equity (BDT 20,069.13mn). car_pct.metric_note: Solo CRAR under Basel III, against a regulatory requirement of 12.50%. First CAR data point available for this bank in this dataset (FY2020-2023 source tables reported Total Capital Fund only, not the ratio). Total Regulatory Capital BDT 28,361.26mn / RWA BDT 575,894.04mn. The Auditors' Report separately states that if the full assessed provision shortfall were recognized, CRAR would fall to approximately (80.00)% to (80.39)%, per two slightly different Bangladesh-Bank-letter-based computations quoted in the Auditors' Report itself.

quarterly_detail.note: Discrete-quarter-alone figures (not annualized), directly reported by the bank as a separate column in H1/Q3 filings. Null for Q1 (cumulative = discrete for a first quarter).

periods.data_gap_note: npl_ratio_pct (Percentage of Classified Investments) and car_pct (CRAR) are not disclosed in this bank's un-audited interim (Q1/H1/Q3) filings -- only in year-end audited financial statements. See the quarterly JSON file's own 'specific_provision_classified_investment_cumulative' line item for the closest available interim asset-quality proxy.
